title: Enforce supplier invoice evidence authorization independently of request path
description:
Stage3 critical authority path repair. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/PurchaseInvoiceController.cs:102-111 returns false for absent request context/path and identity, so supplier invoice evidence routes can execute without live identity/menu/scope. Remove the request-shape bypass and require the existing authoritative supplier-invoice menu/customer scope on every paged/detail/reconciliation/create/update/record/void/allocation operation; preserve original shared invoice/payment capacity transaction locks and all currency/amount semantics. Preserve existing ERP business permissions, data scopes, transactions and numeric validation. Adapt legacy controller fixtures to genuine enabled identities and their existing menu grants in isolated test data only. No Request.Path/environment/blank-context/test-only switch, anonymous fallback, permission expansion, production access or schema change. Genuine SQL uses exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database, refusing existing or wrong targets before access; never drop/reset. Preserve full failing logs. Safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors and full unit suite, plus new authenticated real SQL tests are required; build is not whole phase acceptance.

2026-10-13 verified recovery: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/PurchaseInvoiceController.cs:110-156 still skips menu, scoped query, invoice/source authority for null HttpContext; violates original acceptance requiring identical missing-context authority. Remove RequiresLiveAuthorization and all no-context/null-scope exemptions completely; parse missing current identity safely into null and let existing rules return controlled Unauthorized before queries. Genuine enabled test identities and existing grants/master rows must replace anonymous legacy fixtures. Do not retain or rename the bypass as an internal/test compatibility boundary. Preserve all original failure logs and prior build evidence; no reset of attempt count. Explicit test output/TRX directories .ai/logs/ERP-462 only; no root TestResults artifacts. Safe Release/full units and relevant fresh isolated SQL validation required; no stage acceptance from build.
